entry.title: v1.2.0-build7 released
entry.summary: Corrected the version macros in the header shipped with the development package; build1-6 claimed the previous release. The runtime API was always correct.

entry.title: v1.2.0-build6 released
entry.summary: Updated to Chromium 151.0.7922.108. User scripts now run before the page's own scripts, and JavaScript results are returned as JSON.

entry.title: v1.2.0-build5 released
entry.summary: Hyphenation now works for Western text. The browser no longer fails on exit, and diagnostic images are no longer written unless you ask for them.

entry.title: Western hyphenation now works
entry.summary: Specifying hyphens: auto now breaks Western words at appropriate points, with dictionaries for 52 languages bundled. Justified Western text depends on hyphenation, so previously the shorter the line the wider the word gaps became.

entry.title: Install and update with dnf
entry.summary: Register the repository once and dnf upgrade keeps you current. Packages are signed and the repository ships with gpgcheck=1.

entry.title: v1.2.0-build4 released
entry.summary: Continuously animating pages — Canvas, CSS animation, video — no longer freeze in software mode.

entry.title: GPU rendering works with a single environment variable
entry.summary: Switch to the GPU path with BLINKGTK_GPU_MODE=egl alone. No application code changes required.

entry.title: Reported a vertical-writing line-breaking issue upstream
entry.summary: In vertical writing, a closing bracket at the line end can leave the line half filled. Reported upstream with reproduction steps and measurements.

entry.title: Updated to Chromium 151
entry.summary: Emphasis marks no longer inflate line pitch, and ruby overhang behaves as specified.
